title: WardenPack
description:
This is an old PvP texture pack brought back with a fresh new update.
It keeps the original style while adding cleaner textures and essential PvP features.
The pack combines nostalgia with a smoother and more modern PvP experience.
body:
****This texture pack was originally created and used for PvP several years ago. After rediscovering it, I decided to completely revisit and improve the pack from the ground up while keeping the original style and feel that made it enjoyable to use.****

****The pack has now been heavily updated and refined with a wide range of improvements designed specifically for modern PvP gameplay. Many textures have been redesigned, cleaned up, and optimized to create a smoother and more consistent experience in combat. Alongside visual improvements, I have also added many essential PvP features and quality-of-life enhancements to make the pack both more practical and more enjoyable to use during fast-paced gameplay.****

****This updated version combines the nostalgia of the original pack with a fresh, polished look that fits current Minecraft PvP standards. Whether you enjoy casual fights, competitive practice, or full PvP servers, this pack aims to deliver a clean and responsive experience while still staying true to its original identity.****

===ESSENTIALS===
- small totem pop
- small utilities
- no explotion particles
- no fire particles
- small fire
- old enchantment glint
- crossbow timer
- better hudbar
- brewing guide
- small critical particles
- side shield
- better shield breaking sound
- clean hit sound
